title: Development, validation, and application of a machine learning model to estimate salt consumption in 54 countries.
summary: Primary eLife full text/PDF reports model derivation and validation using 21 surveys (49,776 people), then application to 54 countries (166,677 people); version history lists preprint 2021-09-02 and VOR 2022-01-25.
ai_technology: Supervised regression uses routine survey variables to estimate population mean salt intake; source explicitly limits prediction to population level. Estimates in 54 countries are not direct urine measurements.
